desc:
Etsy shipping profiles and delivery times control what buyers pay and when they expect their order. Ecom Swift LLC checks your settings against real carrier prices and sets up profiles that fit each type of product in your Etsy shop.

## What are Etsy shipping profiles?

An Etsy shipping profile is a saved set of delivery settings that you attach to listings: where you ship from, processing time, the countries you ship to, rates and the delivery estimates buyers see. One profile can serve many listings, so a small mistake in it spreads across the shop.

Ecom Swift LLC builds profiles for each kind of product you sell, tests them at checkout and applies them to your listings in bulk.

## Why wrong shipping settings cost real money

If a profile charges less than the carrier does, you pay the difference on every order. If it charges more, shoppers see a high total and leave. If processing time is too short, you ship late and risk complaints. If it is too long, your items look slow next to similar ones.

Many shops built their profiles in the first week and never looked again. Carrier prices, package sizes and products have changed since. Small gaps add up quietly over many orders.

## How shipping setup affects conversions and margins

Buyers weigh the total cost of an item, not only the price tag. A reasonable shipping charge, shown clearly with a believable delivery estimate, reduces surprises at checkout. Free shipping can attract buyers, but only works when the cost is built into the price, so we work out the math with you before turning it on.

Accurate profiles protect your margin too. When the rates match your real costs, each sale earns what you expected. International settings need extra attention, since rates, customs and delivery times vary by country. We aim to make the settings correct and clear, and results still depend on your products and your buyers.

## What a good shipping setup includes

- One profile for each group of products with similar size and weight.
- Processing times that you can meet on a normal week.
- Domestic rates based on your real carrier prices.
- International rates for the regions you choose to serve.
- A free shipping threshold, only if the numbers support it.
- Delivery estimates that match what carriers actually do.
- Profiles applied to the right listings, in bulk.
- Test checkouts on several listings to confirm the totals.
- A rate sheet and customs or delivery notes for buyers.

## What we do

We begin with a list of what you sell, the sizes and weights of your packages and the carriers you use. We compare that with what your profiles currently charge. Then we build or correct the profiles, adjusting rates, processing time and destinations.

After that, we apply the profiles to the listings you choose. We open sample listings and check what a buyer would pay, so you can see the result before it affects real orders. The Basic package covers one profile and a test. Standard adds up to several profiles, international rates and a rate sheet. Premium covers more profiles, free shipping math, a wider bulk update and notes for buyers about customs. We do not buy labels in this service.

## Do and avoid

**Do:**
- Weigh and measure your packed items, with the packaging.
- Set processing time you can keep on a busy week.
- Review rates whenever your carrier changes prices.
- Test a checkout in more than one country.
- Tell buyers about customs charges where they may apply.

**Avoid:**
- Using a single profile for light and heavy products.
- Offering free shipping without adding the cost to the price.
- Promising delivery dates the carrier cannot keep.
- Leaving old profiles attached to new listings.
- Ignoring the handling cost of packaging materials.

## Who this service is for

It suits a seller who suspects they lose money on shipping but has never checked. It fits a shop expanding to buyers abroad, and an owner who added new product sizes and never updated the profiles.

## What we need from you

Send your carrier price lists or recent label costs, the weights and sizes of your packages and the regions you wish to serve. We join as a manager with limited permissions where Etsy supports it. We never need passwords, and you approve each profile before it goes live.
